title_zh: 基于长程信用分配的 Harness 稳定进化方法
title_en: Stable Harness Evolution via Long-Horizon Credit Assignment

scope.study_focus: long-horizon value of harness modifications; multi-round effect first
scope.evolution_target: ModularRSI basic modular Terminus2 five modules, denoted H0
scope.foundation_stage: shared execution/versioning base + dual-rail smoke (P2A official, P2B branches); not full 60/84

solver.p2b_note: Frozen DeepSeek Flash solver from roles.v0 / meta-harness-repro

evolver.output: modification plan only; may touch multiple modules in general protocol; v1 foundation smoke locks one module

harness.LOCKED_MODULE_policy: single module after calibrate; do not pre-lock observation
harness.license_note: ModularRSI original contributions are CC BY-NC 4.0. Do not vendor upstream source into this private repo.

baseline_control.role: read-only control; not modified in this project

task_sets.train_list_rule: Read train names only from manifest.json or train_120.txt; never hand-fill
task_sets.fix_git_note: fix-git is connectivity smoke only if absent from train; not an evolution task

evaluation.unit: external task tests via Harbor; agent-internal verification is not the final score

retry.retry_when: official reward missing AND failure looks infrastructural
retry.do_not_retry: reward present including 0; agent timeout; limits exceeded; apply-failure

metrics.best_ancestor: diagnostic column only; not primary U

P2B.name: own_branch_miniloop
P2B.shape: same H0 parent → candidates A/B → eval → 1 continuation each

rails.isolation: separate run dirs; shared provider ledger; neither rail mutates the other's version tree

budgets_and_stops.foundation_ready: both P2A and P2B smokes PASS (or INCOMPLETE with explicit external blockers)
